findings.claim: the hook echoes untrusted artifact values; dash and macOS /bin/sh expand backslash escapes in echo, so a value carrying backslash-n forges a second [Totem] line and backslash-c truncates the cure
findings.counterexample: anchor.ref = 2737 + backslash + n[Totem] spec evidence: FORGED printed two [Totem] lines under /usr/bin/dash before the fold

findings.claim: hasUnrenderableHeadingChar had no pinned-set test; an empty body passed

findings.claim: REFLEX_VERSION governs only the AGENTS.md reflex block; the 13 to 14 bump would have churned every consumer block for no content change and never refreshed hooks
findings.counterexample: init.ts installs git hooks outside the reflex-version branch; doctor never reads the constant

findings.claim: safe() did not collapse U+2028/U+2029 and no behavioral test covered its band

findings.claim: no parity pin between hasUnrenderableHeadingChar and the rendered safe()

findings.claim: record residue: getHeadingLevel, totem install-hooks, the DOCUMENT scope clause, the two-line marker prose

verdict: three leg rounds over 3e82124f..3e8d8c02: the slice leg 0/2/7 (folded 523bf274), the re-arm 1 BLOCKING (the dash echo forge) 2/7 (folded acb06915), the second re-arm 0/0/6 with one question (folded 3e8d8c02, prose). f9 and f10 declined as pre-existing and out of scope.
